battle.name: 第二次剛果戰爭
battle.theater: 剛果民主共和國基伍省
battle.brief: 第二次剛果戰爭是中文維基「戰爭列表」所列的衝突，1998年8月因剛果民主共和國進攻基伍省而爆發，戰事其後延伸至盧安達、烏干達與布隆迪境內。線膛砲（Muzzle-loading field gun，1850年）是德國諸邦陸軍早已服役的野戰火砲正式型號，隸屬於陸軍砲兵。

kit.name: 線膛砲
kit.history: 線膛砲是十九世紀中葉德國諸邦陸軍野戰砲兵的制式火砲，配置於獨立砲兵編制，負責伴隨步兵、攻擊堡壘及支援會戰。

countries: 1998年的第二次剛果戰爭，實際上是剛果民主共和國與剛果共和國之間的跨境戰爭，安哥拉亦直接參戰。交戰陣營並非全程固定：卡比拉領導的剛果民主共和國政府最初把流亡者武裝卡塔加虎視為首都內的安全威脅，命令總統警衛隊將其逐出；其後，剛果民主共和國正規軍進入普勒省，與總統帕斯卡爾・利蘇巴的國家軍及反對派忍者民兵交戰。德尼・薩蘇－恩格索倚重的忍者民兵原在普勒北部活動，後來與剛果民主共和國軍及部分卡塔加虎單位形成軍事協同。安哥拉則由普萊拉軍出兵，協助利蘇巴政府守住布拉柴維爾、普勒與通往普安黑角的交通走廊。因此，這不是單一首都衝突，而是國家軍、地方武裝及外來部隊在同一條河、兩片土地與數條戰略走廊上交錯形成的戰爭。
countriesEn: The Second Congo War of 1998 was fundamentally a cross-border conflict between the Democratic Republic of the Congo and the Republic of the Congo, with Angola participating directly. The alignments did not remain fixed throughout the campaign. Laurent Kabila's government in the Democratic Republic of the Congo initially treated the Katangan Tigers, an exile-based armed movement, as a security threat within the capital and ordered the Presidential Guard to drive them out. Its regular forces subsequently entered the Pool Department and fought the national army of President Pascal Lissouba as well as the Ninja militia opposed to Lissouba. The Ninja movement associated with Denis Sassou Nguesso originally operated in northern Pool, but later coordinated militarily with forces from the Democratic Republic of the Congo and with some Katangan Tiger units. Angola deployed the FAPLA to help the Lissouba government hold Brazzaville, the Pool interior, and the transport corridor leading to Pointe-Noire. The war was therefore not an isolated clash in one capital, but a conflict involving national armies, local armed groups, and foreign forces along one river, two states, and several strategic lines of communication.
people: 卡比拉是剛果民主共和國的總統兼最高軍事決策者。他先以總統警衛隊鎮壓首都內的卡塔加虎，之後把正規軍投入普勒戰線，並因邊界指控與利蘇巴政府由合作轉為正面敵對，讓・皮埃爾・本巴則是流亡海外的卡塔加武裝主要政治與組織人物；他的政治影響很大，但前線並非由單一指揮官統一控制。利蘇巴是1997年當選的剛果共和國總統，他既要維持選舉形成的合法政府，又要應付普勒北部尚未平息的忍者起義，後來更須同時面對剛果民主共和國正規軍。薩蘇－恩格索在流亡期間扶植忍者民兵，藉戰局削弱利蘇巴，1999年回國後取得總統職位。安哥拉總統若澤・愛杜阿多・多斯桑托斯授權普萊拉軍介入，重點是支援利蘇巴、阻止戰線延伸至普安黑角與卡賓達方向。各方在前線都曾更換部隊與任務編組，因此決策者的政治目標固然重要，實際戰果仍取決於前線指揮、補給及外來部隊何時抵達。
peopleEn: Kabila was president and the principal military decision-maker of the Democratic Republic of the Congo. He first used the Presidential Guard against the Katangan Tigers in the capital and later committed regular forces to the Pool front. Following mutual accusations across the border, his initially cooperative relationship with the Lissouba government became openly hostile. Jean-Pierre Bemba was the principal political and organizational figure behind the Katangan exile movement; his political influence was considerable, although the front was not controlled by a single commander. Lissouba, elected president of the Republic of the Congo in 1997, had to preserve a government based on the election while confronting the unresolved Ninja revolt in northern Pool and later the regular army of the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Sassou Nguesso supported the Ninja movement from exile, used the war to weaken Lissouba, and returned to the presidency in 1999. Angolan President José Eduardo dos Santos authorized FAPLA intervention to assist Lissouba and prevent the front from extending toward Pointe-Noire and Cabinda. Because units and task organizations changed repeatedly, the goals of these leaders mattered greatly, but battlefield results also depended on local command, logistics, and the arrival of foreign reinforcements.
kits: 雙方步兵最可靠的火力來自蘇聯系輕武器：7.62×39公釐AKM、AK-47與AK-74，搭配同口徑PKM通用機槍；部分單位另有使用7.62×54公釐SKS步槍及12.7×54公釐DShK或NSV重機槍。對裝甲車與據點的主要反裝甲武器是RPG-7及PG-7破甲彈，並配有F1與RGD-5手榴彈。支援火力包括82公厘迫擊砲、105公厘榴砲及122公厘野戰砲。裝甲與機動方面，1998年前已可見M113裝甲運兵車、BRDM-2輪式裝甲車，以及安哥拉與剛果民主共和國方面的T-34-85與T-55坦克；運輸則依靠Ural-375卡車、Toyota Land Cruiser越野車及普通重型貨車。安哥拉空軍可用的MiG-21與Mi-8或Mi-17除作戰鬥與運輸外，也可執行偵察、護送及後勤任務。彈藥補給必須分清7.62×39、7.62×54公釐與12.7公厘三種供應線，RPG火箭、迫擊砲彈及火炮炮彈亦不能互換。輪胎、柴油、車用備件與維修能力往往比步槍數量更早限制持續作戰。這些型號均早於或已在1998年列入相關軍隊裝備，不能據此假定每個前線分隊都配備相同數量。
kitsEn: The most dependable infantry firepower on both sides came from Soviet-pattern light weapons: 7.62×39 mm AKM, AK-47, and AK-74 rifles, supported by 7.62×39 mm PKM general-purpose machine guns. Some formations also used 7.62×54 mm SKS rifles and 12.7×54 mm DShK or NSV heavy machine guns. RPG-7 launchers with PG-7 warheads were the principal weapons against armored vehicles and fixed positions, accompanied by F1 and RGD-5 fragmentation grenades. Supporting fire included 82 mm mortars, 105 mm howitzers, and 122 mm field guns. In the armored and mobility categories, M113 armored personnel carriers, BRDM-2 wheeled armored vehicles, and T-34-85 and T-55 tanks were already present in the inventories of Angola and the Democratic Republic of the Congo by 1998. Logistics depended on Ural-375 trucks, Toyota Land Cruiser utility vehicles, and ordinary heavy cargo trucks. Angolan MiG-21 aircraft and Mi-8 or Mi-17 helicopters could conduct combat, reconnaissance, escort, and transport missions. Ammunition supply had to distinguish between 7.62×39 mm, 7.62×54 mm, and 12.7 mm lines, while RPG rockets, mortar shells, and artillery ammunition were not interchangeable. Tires, diesel fuel, vehicle spares, and maintenance capacity frequently restricted sustained operations before a shortage of rifles did. All these types had entered service before or by 1998, but that does not imply that every front-line detachment possessed identical quantities.
tactics: 首都階段以小隊戰和道路控制為主。總統警衛隊在Barumbu、Camp Luka及通往馬塔迪的交通軸線設置路障，以裝甲車、輕型砲車和迫擊砲封鎖路口；卡塔加虎則分散成小組，利用混凝土掩護、河岸通道和RPG伏擊，避免與警衛隊正面交換火力。進入普勒後，剛果民主共和國把正規營、卡塔加虎及部分忍者武裝混合使用，沿北部邊境至Impfondo、Oyo、Maya-Maya，以及西南面Boma、普安黑角方向推進，目標是切斷布拉柴維爾同普勒內陸及海岸之間的道路、鐵路和河道聯繫。利蘇巴政府以布拉柴維爾為核心，守住Mbaïki至Maya-Maya的交通線，再以普安黑角港維持燃料、外匯與補給。安哥拉部隊則利用普萊拉軍的整編 infantry、火砲及航空支援，沿RN1海岸公路和通往Maya-Maya的走廊反擊，切斷過長的剛果民主共和國補給線。戰役勝負因此不只取決於據點數量，更取決於誰能連續供應砲彈、柴油與維修車件。
tacticsEn: The opening phase centered on small-unit combat and control of roads. The Presidential Guard established barricades around Barumbu, Camp Luka, and the axis leading toward Matadi, using armored cars, light gun vehicles, and mortars to seal junctions. The Katangan Tigers dispersed into small groups, used concrete cover, riverside approaches, and RPG ambushes, and avoided prolonged frontal exchanges with the Guard. After entering Pool, the Democratic Republic of the Congo mixed regular battalions with Katangan Tiger and some Ninja formations, advancing along the northern axis through Impfondo, Oyo, and Maya-Maya, as well as through Boma toward Pointe-Noire in the southwest. Their operational purpose was to sever the road, rail, and river connections linking Brazzaville with the Pool interior and the coast. The Lissouba government used Brazzaville as its principal base, defended the Mbaïki–Maya-Maya route, and relied on the port of Pointe-Noire for fuel, foreign exchange, and supply. Angolan forces countered with organized FAPLA infantry, artillery, and air support, operating along the RN1 coastal road and the approaches to Maya-Maya to sever the overextended supply lines of the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Victory therefore depended less on the number of occupied positions than on the ability to deliver artillery ammunition, diesel fuel, and repair parts continuously.
data: 1998年8月2日，衝突首先在金夏沙Barumbu至Camp Luka一帶爆發，總統警衛隊與卡塔加虎交火；8月5日，聯合國安理會第1154號決議譴責兩國武裝衝突，要求立即停火並尋求協議。8月上旬至下旬，利蘇巴政府與安哥拉部隊鞏固布拉柴維爾及其周邊，尼茲武裝則主要退向普勒北部。9月至10月，剛果民主共和國正規軍由北部邊境及西南通道進入普勒，Impfondo、Oyo、Maya-Maya與Mbaïki之間的反覆攻防成為主戰線。11月至12月，戰火向布拉柴維爾外圍和普安黑角方向擴展，剛果民主共和國軍一度進入普安黑角一帶，爭奪港口與海岸道路，但利蘇巴政府及安哥拉仍守住首都。1999年1月至3月，普萊拉軍增援與利蘇巴政府的反擊迫使戰線向普勒及邊境方向收縮，RN1公路及Maya-Maya周邊仍是反覆交火地點。5月16日，兩國在布拉柴維爾達成停火安排，並由國際觀察機制核查。戰爭通常以1998年8月2日至1999年5月16日界定；各方死亡通報口徑不一，總數缺乏可交叉核對的可靠基礎，因此不作精確總數。
dataEn: On 2 August 1998, fighting first erupted between the Presidential Guard and the Katangan Tigers around Barumbu and Camp Luka in Kinshasa. On 5 August, United Nations Security Council Resolution 1154 condemned the hostilities and called for an immediate cessation and an agreement. From early to late August, Lissouba's government and Angolan troops consolidated Brazzaville and its approaches, while the Ninja forces withdrew mainly toward northern Pool. Between September and October, regular forces from the Democratic Republic of the Congo entered Pool through the northern border and southwestern approaches, and repeated battles developed around Impfondo, Oyo, Maya-Maya, and Mbaïki. From November through December, the conflict spread toward the outskirts of Brazzaville and Pointe-Noire. Forces from the Democratic Republic of the Congo entered the Pointe-Noire area at one stage and contested its port and coastal roads, but the Lissouba government and Angola retained the capital. From January through March 1999, reinforcements from the FAPLA and a government counteroffensive contracted the front toward Pool and the border, with the RN1 road and Maya-Maya remaining contested. On 16 May, the two governments reached a ceasefire arrangement in Brazzaville, with international observers assigned to monitor it. The war is conventionally dated from 2 August 1998 to 16 May 1999. Competing casualty reports cannot be reliably reconciled, so no precise overall total is stated.
cause: 這場戰爭由三層原因交疊而成。最深的一層是剛果共和國尚未解決的選舉與內戰問題：薩蘇－恩格索在1997年敗選後不承認結果，依附普勒北部的忍者民兵；利蘇巴雖取得總統職位，中央政府卻未能完全控制普勒。直接引線則是卡比拉與利蘇巴之間迅速惡化的邊界關係。卡塔加虎在金夏沙受擊後退入剛果共和國，卡比拉指責布拉柴維爾縱容跨境武裝並支援普勒反對派；利蘇巴政府否認指控，反指剛果民主共和國侵犯其領土。剛果民主共和國最初介入時，公開理由是協助利蘇巴平定忍者，實際行動卻逐步轉為控制普勒、包圍首都及海岸交通線。普勒的地理位置因此具有戰略意義：它同時靠近剛果河航路、Maya-Maya與Mbaïki道路、布拉柴維爾以及通往普安黑角的石油走廊。安哥拉的介入則加上區域安全考量、對利蘇巴政府的支援，以及阻止戰事向卡賓達與安哥拉邊境延伸的考量。
causeEn: Three overlapping layers produced the war. The deepest was the unresolved electoral and civil conflict in the Republic of the Congo. Sassou Nguesso did not accept his 1997 defeat and relied on the Ninja militia in northern Pool. Although Lissouba had gained the presidency, his central government did not fully control the department. The immediate trigger was the rapid deterioration of relations between Kabila and Lissouba. After the Katangan Tigers were driven from Kinshasa and moved into the Republic of the Congo, Kabila accused Brazzaville of tolerating armed cross-border incursions and supporting Pool insurgents. The Lissouba government denied the charges and counter-accused the Democratic Republic of the Congo of invading its territory. When the latter initially intervened, its stated purpose was to help Lissouba against the Ninjas, but the operation gradually turned toward control of Pool, encirclement of the capital, and the coastal communication routes. Pool's geography made it strategically important because it lay near Congo River navigation, the Maya-Maya and Mbaïki roads, Brazzaville, and the oil corridor leading to Pointe-Noire. Angola's entry added regional security considerations, support for the Lissouba government, and an effort to keep the conflict away from Cabinda and the Angolan border.
impact: 軍事上，這場戰爭把普勒省變成長期主戰區，也暴露剛果民主共和國軍隊的跨境後勤限制。其部隊雖能迅速奪取Impfondo、Maya-Maya或普安黑角附近的據點，卻很難把砲兵、迫擊砲、燃料與維修車件從金夏沙方向安全送入；卡比拉因此同時面對西部戰局與東部持續存在的武裝問題。安哥拉的直接介入把原本兩國邊境衝突擴大為區域軍事捲入，普萊拉軍必須在普勒、布拉柴維爾外圍及海岸走廊之間調度。普安黑角港一度受戰火影響，其出口與剛果共和國政府的財政、燃料供應受到牽動。外交方面，聯合國先後推動停火與觀察安排，使1999年的停火不只依賴雙方直接談判。政治上，利蘇巴雖在停火時保住總統職位，權力與軍隊控制力卻已受損；薩蘇於同年回國並成為總統，使普勒問題延續到戰爭之後。這只是更長久剛果危機的一環，而不是其終點。各階段傷亡報告彼此矛盾，故無法提供可信的精確總數。
impactEn: Militarily, the conflict turned the Pool Department into the principal theatre and exposed the limits of the Democratic Republic of the Congo's cross-border logistics. Its troops could seize places such as Impfondo, Maya-Maya, or the approaches to Pointe-Noire relatively quickly, but had difficulty delivering artillery, mortar ammunition, fuel, and repair parts safely from the Kinshasa side. Kabila consequently faced a western war while still confronting armed problems in the east. Angola's direct participation expanded a bilateral border conflict into a regional military commitment, requiring the FAPLA to move between Pool, the approaches to Brazzaville, and the coastal corridor. Fighting around Pointe-Noire disrupted port operations at one stage and affected the Republic of the Congo's access to fuel and fiscal revenue. Diplomatically, United Nations cease-fire and observer efforts gave the 1999 settlement an international mechanism rather than leaving it entirely to direct negotiations. Politically, Lissouba retained the presidency at the time of the ceasefire but emerged weakened in both authority and control of the armed forces. Sassou returned to the Republic of the Congo and became president in the same year, carrying the Pool problem beyond the military conclusion of the war. The conflict was one episode within the longer Congo Crisis rather than its conclusion. Casualty totals remain irreconcilable across different reporting systems, so no supposedly precise overall figure is given.
result: 1999年5月16日簽訂的停火安排構成了這場戰爭的軍事終點。剛果民主共和國同意把正規部隊按受監督程序撤往邊界，監察由停火委員會、聯合國及國際觀察人員共同進行；利蘇巴政府保住布拉柴維爾，安哥拉則把主要作戰力量逐步調回本土。剛果民主共和國沒有占領普勒全部地區，也沒有推翻利蘇巴政府；利蘇巴一方雖獲安哥拉援助守住首都與海岸線，也未能消滅北部忍者及卡塔加虎殘部。因此，結果不是任何一方取得決定性的全戰場勝利，而是以剛果民主共和國收縮部署、利蘇巴政府維持首都控制及普勒局勢暫時凍結交換停火。停火沒有終止更大的剛果危機，剛果民主共和國在1998至1999年間仍同時捲入其他方向的內戰；同年稍後薩蘇回國並取得總統職位，才使普勒的政治解決走向另一條道路。就第二次剛果戰爭本身而言，最準確的結論是：有外交框架的停火與有限軍事成果，而不是任何一方完全掌控普勒。
resultEn: The ceasefire arrangement signed on 16 May 1999 formed the military conclusion of the war. The Democratic Republic of the Congo agreed to withdraw its regular troops toward the border under monitored arrangements, with verification conducted by a ceasefire commission, the United Nations, and international observers. The Lissouba government retained Brazzaville, while Angola returned most of its combat forces to the homeland. The Democratic Republic of the Congo did not occupy all of Pool or overthrow the Lissouba government. Conversely, although Lissouba's forces and Angola held the capital and the coastal corridor, they did not eliminate the surviving Ninja and Katangan Tiger formations in the north. The outcome was therefore not a decisive campaign victory for either side. It was a ceasefire purchased through the contraction of the Democratic Republic of the Congo's deployments, the preservation of Lissouba's control of the capital, and the temporary freezing of the Pool front. The ceasefire did not end the larger Congo Crisis, since the Democratic Republic of the Congo remained involved in conflicts in other directions during 1998 and 1999. Sassou's return and assumption of the presidency later that year moved the political solution of Pool onto a different path. For the Second Congo War itself, the accurate conclusion is an internationally monitored ceasefire with limited military gains, rather than complete control of Pool by any party.
